model: fracture official best a6x10w2_tv7 (push90b; selected by train CV .9024; Merlin val .8973 [.8823, .9119])
rule: every component refit on FULL Merlin train (test split never read) or = its saved fold models; inference only from saved files

stacker.kind: S3n = S2 + FT (no FT_pv); 3 site heads StandardScaler+LogisticRegression(max_iter 3000) fit on t_vert / t_rib / t_pel over the train frame (train OOF inputs); case logit = max(site logits)
stacker.missing_inputs: train median (stacker.json medians_train) for FT-type columns and any NaN S2 column

inputs.S2 members (J_add, L_v15, L_v3, L_r, L_r: s2/ (full-train refits, see s2/manifest_s2.json); I_* = mean over expI groups of z(seed-mean site logit) with train-OOF mean/sd in stacker.json zparams
inputs.FT_sp: ft_sp/model_full_s{0,1}.pt (TS Dataset297 encoder stages>=2 + head; scripts_cg/frac_ft_full.py --mode score on crop_prep.py 3 mm spine pack); value = mean of 2 seeds (raw logit)
inputs.FT_sp15: ft_sp15/models/model_f{0-4}_s0.pt (saved fold models of spine15_ft s0_tf2lse; frac15_ft.py --score on spine15_crop.py 1.5 mm crops); value = fold mean
inputs.P15FT: p15ft/s{0,1}/models/model_f{0-4}_s*.pt (pelvis15_ft full_297s_s0/s1 fold models; pv15_ft.py --score on pv15_crop.py ROI, bf16); value = mean of the two seeds fold means (missing if no pelvis ROI -> train median)
inputs.RVRS: zmix(lev28, rs15, a6x10w2_side): probes/lev28/* (rib_feat3 feats3), probes/rs15/* (rs_tile + rs_feat feats), probes/a6/{f_a6,f_a6_s5,f_w2} (rs_tile + rs_feat2 stages 0-2 base+bone); per run: seed-mean ft_side z-scored with that run's train-OOF mean/sd, runs averaged; then zmix z with the combined train-OOF mean/sd (all params in stacker.json zparams)
inputs.PE: probes/pe/pf_ctx (pe15_crop + pe_feat feats; ft_head z with OOF stats)
inputs.PE2: probes/pe2/pe_tv_s{0..30} (same feats; ft_head z per run, mean of 7 runs)
inputs.FT_rib: probes/ftrib/final_f3_{a,b} (feats3; fullfit_rp2.py; ft z per run with OOF stats from integ/rib_ft_runs, mean)

probe_engine: scripts_4090/fullfit_rs.py (rs_probe3 superset) and fullfit_rp2.py (rib_probe2): --mode fit saves models/seed*.pt with train mu/sd; --mode score --score-ids IDS --score-out CSV applies them
scoring_order: crops: pe15_crop, spine15_crop, pv15_crop, crop_prep (3 mm spine), rib15_full boxes + rib_prep ROI + rs_tile (scripts_cg/cpu_chain.sh)

features: pe_feat (bf16), rib_feat3 --maxst 1 --bone --nsec 24 (bf16; scripts_4090/cg/scripts/rib_feat3_lowmem.py = same features with windows run one at a time, used for CG), rs_feat (fp32), rs_feat2 --stages 0,1,2 --wins base,bone (fp32)
integ/integrate.py --cg (reads probes/*/*/cg_scores.csv, s2/s2_scores_merlin_cg.csv, ft_*/cg_scores.csv, p15ft/s*/cg_scores.csv, cg_inputs/ids_main.txt)
